name: Dorm No. 52
source:
A murderous ghost… your dream college… two handsome crushes. Will you enjoy your new life or run for your life? You decide.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]

一个要杀人的鬼魂…你梦想中的大学…两个令你心动的帅哥。你会好好享受新生活，还是会为了保命拔腿就跑？由你决定。
